requirement.text: Users must be informed when they are interacting with an AI system.

analysis.ethical_objective: Ensure transparency by informing users when their interaction is with an AI system.
required_behaviors: Provide users with information indicating that they are interacting with an AI system.
constraints: The information must be provided when users are interacting with the AI system.
verification_targets: Evidence that users receive a disclosure or notice identifying the system as AI during an interaction.
The disclosure or notice is presented in an interaction context accessible to users.
ambiguities: The required timing of the information within an interaction is not specified.
The required format, wording, prominence, accessibility, and communication channel for the information are not specified.
It is not specified whether the notice must be shown once, repeatedly, or continuously.
It is not specified which interaction types or user groups are in scope.
It is not specified how the system should handle interactions that transition between human and AI participants.
unsupported_inferences_to_avoid: Do not infer a specific disclosure phrase, such as 'You are chatting with an AI.'
Do not infer that consent, acknowledgement, or user confirmation is required.
Do not infer a particular interface, modality, or technology for delivering the information.
Do not infer legal, regulatory, accessibility, recordkeeping, or audit requirements.
Do not infer an obligation to disclose model identity, capabilities, limitations, data practices, or human oversight.

initial_draft.title: Disclose AI Interaction
initial_draft.description: As a user, I want to be informed when I am interacting with an AI system, so that I can understand the nature of the interaction.
work_items: Provide a disclosure or notice indicating that the user is interacting with an AI system.
Present the disclosure or notice in a context accessible to the user during an AI-system interaction.
Verify, through an AI interaction, that the user can receive information identifying the system as AI.

issues.problem: The verification work item does not define observable pass/fail conditions. “Verify, through an AI interaction, that the user can receive information” leaves unclear what evidence demonstrates that the disclosure was actually presented during the interaction and identified the system as AI.
issues.recommended_change: Revise the verification work item to require a test of an AI-system interaction that confirms a disclosure or notice identifying the system as AI is presented to the user in the interaction context.
